title: Prompts to Proxies: Emulating Human Preferences via a Compact LLM Ensemble
abstract: arXiv:2509.11311v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as proxies for human subjects in social science research, yet external validity requires matching the response distributions of target human populations. We study population-level survey alignment: reconstructing aggregate survey responses from limited public survey data, without individual-level demographic profiles or model finetuning. We formalize this problem as preference reconstruction: rather than matching proxy agents to demographic profiles, we construct a functional basis of proxy agents and recover population preferences by weighted aggregation. We instantiate this idea via Prompts to Proxies ($\texttt{P2P}$), a two-stage inference-time system. Stage 1 uses structured attribute-based prompting with entropy-guided adaptive sampling to construct a diverse proxy pool spanning the latent preference space. Stage 2 employs L1-regularized regression to select a compact weighted ensemble

translated_title: 从提示到代理：通过紧凑的大语言模型集成模拟人类偏好
translated_abstract: 大语言模型在社会科学研究中越来越多地被用作人类受试者的代理，但外部有效性要求匹配目标人群的响应分布。我们研究人口层面的调查对齐问题：从有限的公开调查数据中重建总体调查响应，而无需个体层面的人口统计特征或模型微调。我们将该问题形式化为偏好重建：不是将代理智能体匹配到人口统计特征，而是构建代理智能体的函数基，并通过加权聚合恢复人群偏好。我们通过 Prompts to Proxies (P2P) 实现了这一想法，这是一个两阶段的推理时系统。第一阶段使用基于属性的结构化提示与熵引导的自适应采样，构建覆盖潜在偏好空间的多样化代理池。第二阶段采用 L1 正则化回归来选择一个紧凑的加权集成。
tldr: 提出P2P两阶段推理时系统，通过熵引导自适应采样构建多样化代理池，再用L1正则化回归选出紧凑加权集成，在无需个体人口特征或模型微调的情况下，从有限公开调查数据中重建人群层面的偏好响应分布。
en_tdlr: P2P is a two-stage inference-time system that reconstructs population-level survey responses from limited public data by building a diverse proxy pool via entropy-guided adaptive prompting and selecting a compact weighted ensemble through L1-regularized regression, without requiring individual demographic profiles or model finetuning.
